cd /tmp || exit; f=/home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1192/local/diff.patch; grep -n '^-' "$f" | grep 'Establish final-tree completion evidence' ; echo "==REMOVED=="; grep '^-.*Establish final-tree' "$f" | sed 's/^-//' | wc -c; echo "==ADDED=="; grep '^+.*Establish final-tree' "$f" | sed 's/^+//' | wc -c
